item.title: Write a Film Club Forum Post
item.prompt_text: Your film club has a film whose subtitles can be small at the bottom of a big screen or larger in a panel just below the picture. You tried both arrangements during a short preview. Describe what you noticed, recommend one arrangement with a reason, and suggest a simple check before the club decides.
item.target_grammar: Past simple for a trial, comparatives for effects, and would for recommendations.
item.target_structure: Describe both trials, explain what each changed, and make a recommendation the club can test.

checklist.point: Describe what you noticed about small subtitles.
Describe what changed with the larger subtitles.
Choose an arrangement and propose a practical check.
